text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Bravo! Just have a listen to those cheers!
They
applaud your victory!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Not only do you have the admiration of
the
crowd, but of future racers among
them who will
strive to surpass your
achievements.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
You have left a mark of hope for all
Umamusume
to see. I thank you for that
display of excellence.
And finally...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
You stand at the peak—the most
excellent trainer
and the most excellent
Umamusume!
